SPECIAL MEETING
  OF THE LANDMARK NOMINATIONS ADVISORY SUBCOMMITTEE
  OF THE CULTURAL HERITAGE COMMISSION

  City of Beverly Hills
  Room 280B
  In-Person/ Teleconference I Video Conference Meeting
  455 North Rexford Drive
  Beverly Hills, CA 90210

  Monday,May 22,2023
  2:00 PM

Pursuant to Government Code Section 54953, members of the Landmark Nominations Advisory
Subcommittee of the Cultural Heritage Commission and staff may participate in this meeting via a
teleconference.  Members of the public can participate in the meeting by using this link:
www.beverlyhills.org/subcommittee (passcode 90210) or by phone at 833-548-0276 (Meeting ID: 844 6491
8768). Written comments may be emailed to commentCHC@beverlyhills.org and will be read at the
meeting.

  SPECIAL MEETING AGENDA

1. PUBLIC COMMENT

2. GOALS & OBJECTIVES OF THE SUBCOMMITTEE
  Review the subcommittee's formal charge and goals, and provide potential modifications

3. DISCUSSION OF POTENTIAL FUTURE NOMINEES FOR LANDMARK DESIGNATION

4. DISCUSSION OF POTENTIAL FUTURE NOMINEES FOR THE GOLDEN SHIELD CULTURAL
  RECOGNITION PROGRAM

5. ADJOURNMENT

  Posted: May 17, 2023

  efforts to accommodate persons with disabilities. If you require special assistance, please call

  notice will help to ensure availability of services.
